verification_policy: Direct research with cross-source classification and acquisition review. Preserve source conflicts and do not infer Ultimate Finish requirements without explicit evidence.

verification_audit.method: Cross-checked the dedicated Xenoverse 2 skill documentation with the current PQ reward guide and the current datamined PQ corpus. The dedicated skill page conflicts with current PQ183 reward evidence on the quest number, so both routes are preserved.
verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation identifies Emperor's Cannon as a Ki Blast Super Attack used by Golden Frieza (Ultra Supervillain), with a 100 Ki cost and a multi-projectile Power of Time interaction.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Current PQ reward documentation and the current datamined PQ corpus place Emperor's Cannon on Parallel Quest 183 — Broly vs. Broly. A dedicated skill page currently lists PQ184 — The Invincible Duo, so the discrepancy is retained rather than silently resolved.
verification_audit.ultimate_finish_policy: Ultimate Finish requirement is recorded as null because the current PQ183 reward evidence identifies Emperor's Cannon in the basic reward row and does not establish an Ultimate Finish-only requirement.
verification_audit.cac_policy: Usability by CaC is recorded as null because the reviewed sources identify the cast user and PQ route but do not provide sufficient direct evidence to assert Future Warrior usability.
verification_audit.damage_policy: No fixed canonical damage value is recorded because the reviewed evidence describes projectile count, stun behavior, and Power of Time scaling rather than a stable database-ready damage value.

records.name: Emperor's Cannon
records.source_quest_or_shop: Parallel Quest 183 — Broly vs. Broly (current PQ reward/datamined evidence); dedicated skill page lists PQ184 — The Invincible Duo; source conflict retained
records.skill_description: Generate and direct a volley of Ki blasts; up to eight projectiles can be produced, with some capable of stunning the target.
records.mechanics_notes: The dedicated skill documentation describes a directable multi-projectile Ki Blast Super with up to eight blasts. Power of Time interacts with the Future Saga Chapter 3 skill set and can increase the projectile output. Exact damage values are intentionally omitted from the canonical record.
